title: For fictional characters, overlay a geometric grid on each face in your…
content: For fictional characters, overlay a geometric grid on each face in your character sheet to reduce Seedance Face ID/age verification false flags while preserving facial structure/consistency and wasting fewer credits.
tips: For fictional characters, overlay a geometric grid on each face in your character sheet to reduce Seedance Face ID/age verification false flags while preserving facial structure/consistency and wasting fewer credits.

en.content:
For fictional characters, overlay a geometric grid on each face in your character sheet to reduce false Seedance Face ID/age verification flags while preserving facial structure and consistency, and wasting fewer credits.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
If you make AI films, this Chinese Seedance trick feels almost illegal to know.

For fictional characters, overlay a geometric grid on each face in your character sheet. It can reduce false Face ID/age flags while preserving structure and consistency. 

Fewer blocks. Fewer wasted credits.

对于虚构角色，在你的角色设定图中给每张脸叠加一个几何网格，可以减少 Seedance Face ID/年龄验证的误判，同时保留面部结构/一致性，并减少不必要的 credits 浪费。

--- 引用推文 ---

更少的 block。更少浪费的 credits。
